Run the claims reserving application

Source: R/reserving_tool_global.R
run_shiny_reserving_tool.Rd

Opens NetReserve, a shiny application for claims reserving: it loads a claims triangle (an example, or a file with a row per origin and development period or a row per origin), lets the user choose the development factors (their average, the calendar periods used, link ratios left out, a tail factor or curve), compares the chain ladder, Bornhuetter-Ferguson, Benktander and Cape Cod ultimates and loss ratios of each origin, and measures the uncertainty of the reserves with Mack's standard errors and a bootstrap.

Usage

run_shiny_reserving_tool()

Value

A shiny app object. Printing it, as happens when the function is called at the console, opens the application; it can also be passed to shiny::runApp().

See also

chain_ladder, bornhuetter_ferguson, cape_cod and bootstrap_chain_ladder, the methods of the application; run_shiny_simulator, run_shiny_distribution_fitting_tool and run_shiny_glm_fitting_tool, the package's other applications.

Examples

if (interactive()) {
  run_shiny_reserving_tool()
}
